entries.title: Psalms 137:1
segments: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 137:2
segments: Upon the willows in the midst thereof We hanged up our harps.

entries.title: Psalms 137:3
segments: For there they that led us captive required of us songs, And they that wasted us [required of us] mirth, [saying], Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 137:4
segments: How shall we sing Jehovah's song In a foreign land?

entries.title: Psalms 137:5
segments: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget [her skill].

entries.title: Psalms 137:6
segments: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, If I remember thee not; If I prefer not Jerusalem Above my chief joy.

entries.title: Psalms 137:7
segments: Remember, O Jehovah, against the children of Edom The day of Jerusalem; Who said, Rase it, rase it, Even to the foundation thereof.

entries.title: Psalms 137:8
segments: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed, Happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee As thou hast served us.

entries.title: Psalms 137:9
segments: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones Against the rock.
